case_scope: United States high-income/high-wealth tax enforcement and legal durability subsystem case

enforceability_and_remedy_access.note: Large tax gap and targeted recoveries show enforceability matters; GAO identifies capacity gaps.

high_wealth_audit_capacity.note: GAO recommends improvements in research data, model assessment, staffing, training, and centralized management. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: OECD taxation-and-inequality evidence is now bound to the high-wealth audit-capacity burden.

administrative_capacity.note: Targeted initiatives show capacity gains, but durability remains capacity- and funding-sensitive.

legal_attack_surface.note: Moore leaves design constraints around direct wealth-tax pathways unresolved.

sanctions_and_collection_finality.note: Recoveries demonstrate collection potential for high-wealth delinquent-debt and nonfiler initiatives.

proof_debt: update audit workforce and high-wealth case-cycle data
map partnership trust private-fund and private-business audit capacity
separate tax gap components by top-tail complexity

opening_package.rail_lane: data linkage and high-wealth audit teams
opening_package.hardening_lane: stable funding and centralized case management
opening_package.monitoring_lane: tax gap and high-wealth collection outcomes

reopening_triggers: new Supreme Court or federal appellate tax decision

enforceability_remedies_capture_resistan.why: High-wealth enforcement capacity is not yet stable enough for comfort certification.

legal_durability.why: Potential top-tail instruments require careful constitutional design.

evidence_debt_register.question: Can the U.S. sustain high-income/high-wealth enforcement capacity across political cycles?
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: IRS staffing, audit-rate, case-cycle, and collection trend updates; GAO/TIGTA oversight

validation_notes: Subsystem case; updates but does not replace United States country case.
rev0344 binds formerly unused source S06 to `high_wealth_audit_capacity` so active evidence lineage no longer leaves this source floating outside a case.
